law: Use the File Provider UI extension to add custom actions to your File Provider extension.
After the user is finished, you must explicitly cancel or complete the action.
Use the key to enable or disable actions based on the selected file provider item.
Your action must have a predicate or the system won’t display it in the action menu.
To always show an action, use .
You can use predicates to test the value of any of the object’s properties.
You can also use predicates to test custom data that you’ve added to the item’s dictionary.
